description: Header file defining the AddressInfo class and related components for DNS address resolution in the net namespace, including system call encapsulation and iterators.

classes.name: AddressInfo
classes.description: Encapsulates system call to get address info and provides iteration over results.

classes.name: AddrInfoGetter
classes.description: Provides an interface for getaddrinfo calls, mainly for testing.

methods.name: AddressInfo::Get
methods.description: Performs address resolution, optionally using a custom getter.

methods.name: AddressInfo::begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to start of address info list.

methods.name: AddressInfo::end
methods.description: Returns iterator to end of address info list.

methods.name: AddressInfo::GetCanonicalName
methods.description: Retrieves the canonical name of the address.

methods.name: AddressInfo::IsAllLocalhostOfOneFamily
methods.description: Checks if all addresses are localhost of the same family.

methods.name: AddressInfo::CreateAddressList
methods.description: Creates an AddressList from the address info.

methods.name: AddrInfoGetter::getaddrinfo
methods.description: Performs getaddrinfo system call, virtual for testing.
